{{Top|leg}}
'''Tabac''' was a substance. Two varieties were [[carababba tabac]] and [[havao tabacc]]. At least some forms of tabac could be smoked recreationally in [[Cigarra/Legends|cigarras]] or in [[tabac pipe]]s, producing smoke with a distinctive odor.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Like [[t'bac]], tabac is a stand-in for real-world [[Wikipedia:Tobacco|tobacco]]. However, [[Tobacco/Legends|tobacco]] itself has also appeared in the ''Star Wars'' universe.
